incidents.summary: An Australian court found Plus500AU's arbitration clause unfair and void, a ruling upheld on appeal in September 2026, after which Plus500 sought permission to appeal to the High Court.

sources.title: Full Federal Court dismisses Plus500 bid to arbitrate trading class action | Australasian Lawyer
sources.quote: The primary judge found that the arbitration clause was an unfair contract term under s. 12BF of the Australian Securities and Investments Commission Act 2001 (Cth).

incidents.summary: Plus500 paid a €550,000 Belgian regulatory fine for offering CFDs without the required prospectus and failing to submit advertisements, and closed its Belgian website while denying wrongdoing.

sources.title: Plus500
sources.quote: In April 2017, Plus500 paid a €550,000 fine to Belgium's FSMA for offering CFDs without the required prospectus and failing to submit ads to the regulator.

sources.title: Plus500
sources.quote: Although Plus500 denied any wrongdoing, it complied with FSMA's demand to close its Belgian website and inform Belgian clients of the issue, offering free account closures.

incidents.summary: An Israeli court approved litigation of a class action alleging that Plus500 selectively paused put-option sales for 90 minutes following the Brexit referendum.

sources.title: Court approves class action on alleged Plus500 manipulation - Globes
sources.quote: In the request, it was claimed that trading was paused for 90 minutes only for those asking to sell put options.

sources.title: Court approves class action on alleged Plus500 manipulation - Globes
sources.quote: According to Torgeman, Plus500 did not renew options trading for 90 minutes, which violates many clauses in the Securities Law, and the aim was to prevent Plus500 from making losses.

incidents.summary: Plus500 corrected its 2017 annual report after admitting in February 2019 that a drafting error had obscured a $103 million loss from customers' trading positions.

sources.title: Plus500 to launch shares trading in battle with Hargreaves | This is Money
sources.quote: Plus500 shares crashed last year after it was forced to correct its 2017 annual report, causing substantial embarrassment.

sources.title: Plus500 to launch shares trading in battle with Hargreaves | This is Money
sources.quote: The company initially said it had not suffered losses from punters' trading positions, but in February 2019 it admitted to a 'drafting error' after the company's finances showed it took a $103million (£77million) trading hit in 2017.
